# Agents and Modes

This repository supports agent-driven workflows for development and operations.

## Primary usage modes

- Default coding mode for repository changes
- Skill-guided mode via `.github/skills/*`
- Instruction-governed mode via `.github/instructions/*`

## Where to start

- Read `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
- Read `.github/instructions/README.md`
- Read `.github/skills/README.md`

## Quasi-MCP context

This repository exposes a single-endpoint orchestration model documented in:

- `docs/shared/MCP_AND_QUASI_MCP.md`
